summary: Targeted long-video regression harness updated for /studio iframe flow (iteration34), but end-to-end assertions could not complete because long-clip readiness gate in iframe timed out before scrub/playback/export checks executed.

integration_issues.flow: Studio iframe import readiness (long local asset via #clipInput)
integration_issues.issue: Upload/status network calls fire, but harness times out waiting for a deterministic long clip candidate with wc+wcProxy ready in frame context; core scrub/playback/export assertions are blocked.

action_items: Stabilize fixture selection for the newly imported long clip in iframe context (avoid ambiguous pre-existing project clips).
Expose a deterministic clip-ready signal/hook for wc+wcProxy on imported clip, then rerun scrub/playback/export assertions.
After import readiness is deterministic, validate all required checks in this order: corrected scrub math, 10s real rAF playback source/proxy, wcExportSeek accuracy, mobile pool4 with reused cookies.
critical_code_review_comments: Studio runtime relies heavily on global mutable state, making deterministic QA harnessing fragile when project preloaded clips and fresh imports coexist.
A stable test hook for 'imported clip fully ready (wc + wcProxy)' is missing, causing repeated timeout-based fixture races.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness now uses /studio?project=... + data-testid=studio-iframe, blocks project/tracks writes for safety, reuses single login session, and persists report on failure. Current blocker is deterministic identification/readiness of the imported long clip (wc+wcProxy) before assertions. Last failure in /app/test_reports/frontend_long_preview_regression_iter34.json is timeout in import readiness wait; network confirms /api/media/upload and /status were hit.
rca of the issue: RCA: this is a fixture determinism failure, not yet a confirmed product scrub/playback bug. Reproduction: run python /app/frontend/tests/test_long_preview_regression_iter34.py. Script logs in once, opens /studio iframe, sets #clipInput with /tmp/beatcut_long_assets/h264_longgop_1280x720_185s.mp4, then times out while waiting for a unique long clip candidate with both wc and wcProxy ready. Presence of pre-existing project clips and async proxy generation creates ambiguous clip selection and readiness race. Mitigation: add deterministic imported-clip identity (e.g., returned mediaId binding) and explicit ready signal before core assertions.
